risk_factors.heading: We are highly dependent on foreign sales, suppliers, and operations, which exposes us to foreign political and economic risks.
risk_factors.quote: Our reliance on foreign operations, foreign suppliers, maintenance of substantially all of our finished goods inventory at foreign locations and significant foreign sales exposes us to foreign political and economic risks

risk_factors.heading: Geopolitical instability in the Middle East may disrupt critical semiconductor materials, increase fuel costs, and adversely affect our ability to meet customer demand.
risk_factors.quote: Geopolitical instability and conflicts in the Middle East, including military activity and escalating tensions involving Iran, create significant uncertainty for global markets, including energy and materials markets
